articleTitle: Crop Classification on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In this paper, we combine image processing and deep learning to achieve crop classification recognition. Crop detection is based on deep learning of convolutional neural networks to capture image features and determine various types of crops. Through the steps of image pre-processing, feature extraction, data augmentation, identification and classification, the crop images are identified and classified. The proposed crop species recognition system is divided into three major parts. We use image pre-processing then cut down the crop feature images, and use Efficientnet-B0 as the backbone for crop classification in this paper. The accuracy of 99.3% is obtained in crop classification recognition.

articleTitle: Edge AI - Use Case on Google Coral Dev Board Mini
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: The Google Coral Dev Board Mini leads to a great opportunity in developing applications, using object detection or image classification on the edge by having an affordable price at the same time. The evaluation board provides easy testing of AI on the edge implementations using an Edge TPU coprocessor with overall 4 TOPS. By using performance benchmarks to compare the Dev Board with the Dev Board Mini, clear differences could be identified. The Dev Board Mini turns out to have a two to fifteen times slower inference times than the Dev Board compared on the same object detection and image classification models. When running a custom trained face mask detection model using the EfficientDet-liteO architecture the Dev Board Mini still achieves 6 fps, suitable for low cost Edge AI applications.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of LSTM and BILSTM Network-Based Methods in PV Power Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: With the widely deployment of PV power installations, the intermittent operation property comes from PV power cause various impacts to electric grid. It is thus necessary to seek effective prediction technologies in order to well manage the PV power generation. Recently, many deep learning-based methods are introduced in renewable energy predictions due to their outstanding performance. To follow this technical trend, this paper gives a comparative analysis in using LSTM and BILSTM network-based methods for PV power generation prediction. Data collected from a 2.28 MW campus PV site are used for testing and validating of introduced prediction methods. Result shows that BILSTM presents the better performance than traditional LSTM in PV power generation prediction.

articleTitle: Solar Photovoltaic Power Generation Prediction based on Deep Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In recent years, renewable energy power generation has received more and more attention. Since the forecast of electricity generation is helpful for properly using and managing electricity. Therefore, this study uses time series analysis and deep learning methods, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN), and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), to forecast solar power generation. Furthermore, this study also uses different time intervals (every ten minutes, every thirty minutes, hourly, daily) to forecast the power generation and evaluate their performances. In comparing the four deep learning models, the prediction performance of LSTM is the best, while the performance of the TCN model is poor. In addition, the time interval length greatly influences the prediction performance. The time interval is divided into smaller, and the performance of various deep learning models is relatively good and stable; otherwise, the performance of the models is poor.

articleTitle: Combining Augmented Reality and Multi-User Remote Collaboration to Improve Sustainable Agriculture and Economy
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Agri-food education activity becomes more and more important as modern agriculture has caused damage to biological ecology. However, the activity is faced with a lack of expert human resources and motivation to participate. It results in ineffective cognition of healthy consumption. In this study, a novel model of multi-user remote collaboration using wearable augmented reality (AR) that aims to improve participants' motivation is proposed. At present, the system only proposes concepts and prototype designs, expert interviews and participant interviews will be used to improve the system in the future. The expected results of this study are as follows. Using the proposed model, which could increase participants’ motivation and reduce over-reliance on experts in the activity, to solve the lack in the above. Finally, through prototyping and interview comments, five key points about how the techniques improve problems in the activity are concluded at the end of this paper, providing relevant studies and departments as references.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of a Grid-connected Large-scale DC Microgrid with a Hybrid Wind/Solar Farm
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Stability performance of a grid-connected largescale DC microgrid (DCMG) with a hybrid wind farm (WF) and solar farm (SF) is evaluated in this paper. The studied DCMG comprises an equivalent aggregated (EA) SF and an EA WF based on permanent-magnet synchronous generator (PMSG). The AC output of the EA WF is transformed to a DC quantity through an EA voltage-source converter (VSC), which is integrated with the DC output of the EA DC-DC converter of the EA SF. The DC quantity of the DCMG is transformed to an AC quantity to send to an AC power grid through an EA voltage-source inverter (VSI), a step-up power transformer, and transmission lines. Small-signal stability of the studied DCMG under various chosen operating points is achieved using eigenvalue analysis. Dynamic simulations and transient responses of the studied DCMG under various disturbances are also completed and evaluated.

articleTitle: Engineering Design of Soft Gripper and Manufacturing by TPE Hollow Injection Molding
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: This study presented the injection molding optimization method through Moldex 3D simulation in manufacturing TPE soft grippers. Subsequently, quantify the performance of the soft gripper by using FEM simulation to validate the concept and the design structure of the gripper. TPE soft gripper manufacturing using TPE hollow injection molding was demonstrated, as were experimental results. According to the simulation results, a soft gripper is easy to manufacture. Furthermore, the results show that the FEM simulation and experimental results are remarkably similar.

articleTitle: AI Food Recommendation Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In an information-rich generation, recommendation systems is very important. Hence, in this paper we use the Google Map API and the feedback record of user to build data set on database for the AI (Artificial Intelligence) food recommendation systems. In order to make a recommendation system that knows more than the user, we combine the indispensable food and drink according to the preferences of users to recommend the favorite of users. That is, the AI food recommendation system uses GAE (Graph Autoencoder) and regional filtering to predict the favorite of users. Besides, the AI food recommendation system is proposed to use GAE and regional filtering to predict the user's favorite degree by means of deep learning, and then push it to the user through the Line Bot that can recommend the store to the favorite food of users on nearby, and then feedback to our system after the user uses it, which makes the proposed system more complete and accurate.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Reinforcement Learning Based Approach of Energy Management Optimization for Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: We have focused on the Energy Management System to generate much of Renewable Energy (RE) from available resources. The challenges are fluctuations and mismatches occur between supply and demand of power, to balance these we have proposed Enhanced Reinforcement Learning Based Method (ERLBM), which improves the optimized load of energy mostly from renewable resources – Solar Panels (SP) by using SARSA Algorithm of Reinforcement Learning approach. Our main objective is to maximize the harvesting Renewable Energy (RE) and minimize consumption of Fossil fuel Energy (FFE).

articleTitle: An Evaluation of Cybersecurity Risks of DLMS/COSEM Smart Meter Using Fuzzing Testing
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Since smart meters are IoT devices that can share energy usage information to users and third-party service providers, any vulnerability of smart meters that can be exploited by hackers is a threat to the reliability of smart grids. The purpose of this paper is to explore the possibilities of DoS attacks to smart meters. Our research focuses on the High-Level Data Link Control layer of DLMS/cosEM smart meters. The testing cases are generated by fuzzing testing methods according to the HDLC specifications. The CTT 3.1 is used as the client sending requests to the smart meter server. The responses of the server are then recorded and analyzed for potential vulnerabilities. The results show that the fuzzing test cases on the buffer overflow/underflow category generate most of the abnormal responses.

articleTitle: Binarization of Color Document Image Based on Adversarial Generative Network and Discrete Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Document binarization is an important task to separate the foreground text information in the document image from the background, which is generally applied to the digital archive of historical documents. This paper proposes to use the generative adversarial network for training with a small amount of data. In the first stage, discrete wavelets are used for image enhancement of four-channel images, and local binarization and global binarization are trained separately to obtain the final result in the second stage. The experimental results show that our proposed method has better performance than the classical algorithm on the DIBCO dataset.

articleTitle: Hardware Acceleration of YOLO-based Convolutional Neural Network Detector by Deep Learning Processor Unit for Intelligent Autonomous Mover
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: For intelligent autonomous vehicles, they play an important role in user-friendly usage in crowded environments, so the recent focus has been on providing object recognition and collision avoidance functions. In this study, a Xilinx Deep Learning Processor Unit (DPU)-based Light Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model was implemented for object detection and classification, and FPGA-based hardware acceleration was used to efficiently detect pedestrians and other objects. With the DPU-based implementation, the accuracy of the proposed object classification and face orientation detection model reaches up to 90% on image datasets collected in supermarkets. Compared to previous GPU-based software implementations, the proposed approach provides better frames-per-second (FPS) performance for real-time applications.

articleTitle: Establish a Dynamic Detection System for Metal Bicycle Frame Defects Based on YOLO Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: The purpose of this research is to develop a real-time bicycle frame's defect detection system using YOLO (You Only Look Once) and machine vision. Firstly, the defect locations are manually selected and a database is established. Next, a Darknet method is used to train the YOLO model. Its static detection accuracy rate is 92.6%, and then the static training model is combined with a robotic arm and an industrial camera to perform dynamic detection verification. The result shows that its detection rate reaches 87%. Finally, the above-mentioned defect detection technology is used with the detection machine to complete the development of the online defect detection system.

articleTitle: Estimation of monthly air temperature using Random Forest algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Air temperature (Ta) measurements can be obtained from the ground weather stations with high accuracy and temporal frequency. Nevertheless, the weather stations are limited with spatial coverage because of their sparse distribution. Fortunately, satellite data with the advantage of high spatial coverage can provide us land surface temperature (LST) observations for further extracting Ta through their strong relationship. In this study, we applied Random Forest (RF) to estimate monthly Ta with l-km resolution across Taiwan in 2020. The variables considered in the RF model include air temperature observations, LST version 6 from Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS), Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), Normalized Difference Latent Heat Index (NDLI), altitude, longitude, latitude, and albedo. To assess the RF model’s performance, we employed 5-fold cross-validation and used the coefficient of determination (R2), root-mean-square of error (RMSE), and mean absolute error (MAE) as the performance measurement. The results show excellent five-fold cross-validated performance of the RF model, with $\mathrm{R}^{2}$ of 0.965, RMSE of 0. 98°C, and MAE of 0. 73°c. The results indicate that Ta can be accurately estimated using the RF prediction model, even in Taiwan, with complex topography and weather patterns.

articleTitle: Effect of Different Training Algorithms in Artificial Neural Networks on the Rotor Unbalance Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: A neural network simulator is designed to predict unbalance in a turbine-bearing system. Artificial intelligence (AI) techniques for machine diagnostics and prognostics are gaining traction and are predicted to prove fruitful shortly. In this research, multi-layer feedforward neural networks (FNNs) with different training algorithms have been employed for rotor unbalance diagnosis. The rotor is derived from physical theories and bearing parameters are identified via the particle swarm optimization (PSO) method using the operational data acquired from bearing sensors. Following that, the physical model is used to generate numerous sets of simulated data sets for FNN. The results show that Levenberg-Marquardt (LM) named trainlm algorithm that single layer with 50 neurons show the least RMSE and superiority testing performance over the other algorithms.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Method for Hour-ahead PV Output Forecast with Historical Data Clustering
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: An accurate forecast of the photovoltaic (PV) output can indispensably enhance the stability of power supply. However, the effectiveness of prediction results highly depends on many factors and the data preparations are also an essential process to be considered. The focus of this paper is to classify PV data types by density-based spatial clustering of applications with noise (DBSCAN). Then, the procedure for historical data clustering and for hour-ahead PV output forecast implemented by back propagation neural network (BPNN) model is present. Forecasted results show that data clustering provided by DBSCAN can efficiently classify the PV data types for input to BPNN to achieve better accuracy.

articleTitle: A research on smart machine tool’s processing parameter governed with monitored vibration data
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In all the processing time, the data of cutting vibration and temperature rising of axis have been monitored. After screening all of them by Edge Computing Unit, and be transferred to cloud server as the materials for machine learning. Then, the guiding rule of optimize processing parameter were got. Under the Upgrading ability of above, the intelligent vibration governing ICP, G. LINC-350 system, made the GTW-1500Y (GOODWAY Machine Corp.) own the ability of production efficiency of has been improved by 15% with optimize machining parameters. And also, with the ability of cutting quality and backlash error alarm has been provided. These results are verified by PMC (a third party). In other words, this research results are successful and proven!

articleTitle: Steel billet serial number detection based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Nowadays, steel embryos are necessary materials for human, and steel embryos can be used in shipbuilding, bridges, pressure vessels, and mechanical parts. The steel embryos are formed by a series of physical and chemical reactions of iron ore, limestone and coking coal through a shaft furnace. After roller compaction, the steel embryos are gradually formed, then a set of serial numbers will be given by the thermal printing machine. These numbers will determine which the processing plant will be sent. In order to speed up the classification of steel embryos and reduce human resources, we use YOLOv4-tiny (You Only Look One version4-tiny) for serial number detection.

articleTitle: Ultraviolet photodetector based on ZnO nanorod by hydrothermal method
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In this research, Zinc Oxide nanorod (ZnO NRs) ultraviolet photodetectors (UV PDs) were synthesized through hydrothermal method and fabricated on glass substrate. The material analysis revealed the surface morpholofy and optical properties of the ZnO nanorod. Results from I-V characteristics displayed that ZnO nanorod UV PDs have great sensitivity and stability. This research approve that ZnO NRs could be a good option for develop UV PDs.

articleTitle: Power forecasting of photovoltaic system using environment data and weather information
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Solar energy is a very important technology for the development of renewable energy in the world. However, solar energy is with the disadvantage of intermittent power generation and cannot be supplied around all day. In order to increasing the accuracy of photovoltaic modules in forecasting the power generation, this study is applied the Internet of Things technology to detect the environmental data of photovoltaic power generation, and uploads the detected data to the database via the internet. These are applied to train and update the weights of fuzzy neural networks for modeling and forecasting. This study attempts to compare the impact of only using environmental information and adding weather forecast information on the training results.

articleTitle: A Weighted Circular Algorithm Incorporated with Genetic Algorithms in RSSI Positioning Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: The Received Signal Strength Indication (RSSI) technique is easy to be implemented in positioning systems. However, the noise influences accuracy significantly. A weighted circular algorithm (WCA) incorporated with Genetic Algorithms (GA) is proposed to reduce the positioning errors. The simulation and experimental results confirm the enhancement of positioning error reduction.

articleTitle: Boost the Performance of Model Training with the Ray Framework for Emerging AI Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Ray is a high-performance distributed execution framework aimed at large-scale machine learning and reinforcement learning applications. We propose a method to alleviate the heavy burden of parameter servers in Ray, leading to a reduction of 50% of training time with almost the same model accuracy.

articleTitle: An Efficient Fault-Tolerant Winograd Convolution for Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Recent advances in artificial intelligence mainly focus on acceleration and reliability in safety-critical applications. Winograd Convolution has been proved to possess both potentialities on acceleration and fault tolerance. However the state-of-the-art ternary modular redundancy approach suffers triple computation overhead and unsuitable for most CNN with smaller kernels. In this paper, AN-code self-checking technique is applied for helping the proposed double modular redundancy technique. From evaluation and experimental results, for an F(32x32,3x3) convolution, 75% of multiplications and 42dB of errors and overflows can be reduced. Compared with the stateof-the-art fault-tolerant Winograd convolution, 33% of extra multiplication count overhead can be saved. As for the fault tolerance, the block error rate can be also reduced by A/2 folds.

articleTitle: Using Deep Learning Technology for Abnormal Component Identification in Smart Manufacturing Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: A smart manufacturing cloud platform provides real-time production progress and quality control information which provides management with the ability to keep track of production dynamics. The wide range of mechanical equipment components in the factory works against quality control personnel records and has an impact on productivity. This paper proposes deep learning technology for abnormal component identification in a smart manufacturing cloud platform. The proposed cloud platform enables quality control staff to check the function of equipment parts and components, by uploading real-time images to help identify abnormal components and to obtain information such as names and model numbers. It can supply maintenance staff with accurate inspection record information for follow-up actions to be taken.

articleTitle: Power Smooth of a Hybrid PV-Wind Microgrid Using a Hybrid Energy-storage System with a Designed Adaptive Fuzzy Logic Controller
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: This paper designs an adaptive fuzzy logic controller (AFLC)for power management of a hybrid energy-storage system (HESS) containing a vanadium redox flow battery (VRFB) and a supercapacitor (SC). The studied hybrid wind-PV microgrid (MG) is connected to the IEEE 14-bus multimachine system using optimal designed capacity of the proposed HESS. The main research includes the design of an AFLC for the HESS and the design of the optimal capacity for the HESS. A probability approach is used to determine the rated power and capacity of the HESS, while an AFLC for power distribution of the HESS is designed to effectively utilize individual ESS’s characteristics. Different cases of the studied system are analyzed to investigate the effects of the selected capacity joined with the designed AFLC on smoothing power for the studied system.

articleTitle: Visual Interpretability of Deep Learning Models in Glaucoma Detection Using Color Fundus Images
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: With the advancement of deep learning in many computer vision applications, the computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) systems were developed using the deep learning approaches to assist physicians in clinical diagnosis as a second opinion. Many studies have reported plausible performance of the deep learning models on glaucoma detection simply based on fundus images. However, the mechanism of the deep learning models in detecting glaucoma using color fundus is still not clear. Therefore, the deep features extracted by the deep learning models were discussed in this study to provide the visual interpretability for the frameworks of deep convolutional neural network (DCNN) in glaucoma assessment. In our experiments, 986 fundus photographs were collected from National Taiwan University Hospital Hsin-Chu Branch, categorized into two groups: the experimental group of 512 glaucomatous cases with ganglion cell complex (GCC) impairment and the control group of 474 non-glaucomatous cases with normal GCC thickness. The experimental results show the deep learning models mainly focus on the areas of optic nerve head (ONH) for the diagnosis of glaucoma, which is accordant to the clinical rules in glaucoma assessment. Surprisingly, the DCNN models can still achieved high prediction accuracy in detecting the glaucomatous cases with the cropped images of macular areas only. Several cases show the model's focus areas correspond to the region with GCC impairment. The results imply the deep learning models can detect the morphologically detailed alterations in fundus photographs, which may be beyond experts’ visualization.

articleTitle: Modeling and Testing of the Utility Interface for Photovoltaic System under Full-scale and Down-scale Inverter System
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In this paper, the full-scale and down-scale testing of a 65kW utility-interconnected PV system is presented and compared with the simulation results. In order to understand the testing performance, the IEC 61727-2004 compatible standard CNS 15382:2017 is adopted to evaluate the utility-interconnected PV system. Both the utility compatibility and personnel safety with equipment protection are tested. The testing results with over/under grid voltage, over/under grid frequency and power factor conditioning are offered to verify the utility-interconnected PV system.

articleTitle: Implementation of Smart Transportation Application Using YOLO Deep-Learning Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Parking and running red lights are the major problems in traffic violations. This study presents two application systems for finding parking spaces and controlling traffic lights. An intelligent traffic light system adaptively controls the time of traffic lights so that the period of green lights is adjusted according to the real-time traffic flow. The traffic jam is thus effectively reduced. An intelligent parking system is also implemented to help drivers find parking spaces efficiently. Initially, a web camera is utilized to capture images. Hence, vehicles are identified to compute the remaining number of parking spaces. A website shows the remaining parking spaces. This system can help a user to find suitable parking spaces quickly. Therefore, parking violations are reduced. The YOLO (You Only Look Once) neural network is employed to identify vehicles, where the networks are trained through transfer learning. Only a small quantity of training images is required. The experimental results show that the vehicle identification accuracy rate can reach 93%, the recall rate reaches 83%, and the overall F measure reaches 87.7%. Therefore, the vehicle identification system can be applied to intelligent traffic light control and roadside parking spaces.

articleTitle: Optical dual sensor single fiber Pt(II) complex coated perovskite quantum dots green for oxygen and nitric oxide gas detection
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: This research represents new optical sensing for gases that simultaneously detect oxygen and nitric oxide based on a single fiber. Where Platinum tetrakis (pentafluorophenyl)-porphyrin (PtTFPP) Pt(II) complex in cellulose acetate (CA) matrix used as the O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> sensitive dye, and perovskite quantum dots (PQDs) green used as NO sensitive dye. PQDs green used as the NO sensing dye, coated on the surface platinum tetrakis (pentafluorophenyl) porphyrin Pt(II) complex single fiber produced approach by electrospinning technique. The fluorescence uses an LED wavelength peak of 380 nm to get emissions. In this study, the given experimental results show that the sensitivity of O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and NO sensors are 10.7 and 2.7, respectively. The proposed optical dual sensor for detecting O2 and NO sensing offers high potential in environmental, biological, and industrial fields due to the fabrication process’s low cost and simplicity.

articleTitle: A V-band Low Noise Amplifier in 90-nm CMOS by Inductive Coupling Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: A low-noise amplifier (LNA) with three commonsource stages designed in a 90-nm CMOS process technology for V-band applications is proposed in this conference paper. By using the coupling effect between the gate biasing inductor and source degenerative inductor, we can boost the gain and reduce the noise figure. The proposed LNA achieved a peak measured gain of 11.14 dB at 67 GHz. The measured lowest noise Figure (NF) is 4.99 dB at 67 GHz. The proposed circuit draws a 17.64 mW dc-power from a 1.2-V supply.

articleTitle: Mobile Edge Computing for Rapid deployment Object Detection System
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In the past, the process of transferring data collected by IoT devices or mobile devices has data leakage, personal privacy, and information security issues since object detection systems have mostly sent data to the cloud for processing and storage. To solve this problem, we implement object recognition and tracking function in JavaScript on the front end, and set up the CRUD operation API in Python on the back end, so that users can directly perform object recognition on the computer or mobile browser, and manage the database on the web through the API. It enables the process from deployment to data transfer in a very short time.

articleTitle: Delay-Based TCP with Pacing and ECN for Solving Incast Problem in Data Center Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: This paper proposes a delay-based TCP variant, TCP-VPECN, which aims to solve the Incast problem in data center networks by using pacing and Explicit Congestion Notification (ECN). As observed by NS-2 simulations, TCPVPECN can utilize idle bandwidth more rapidly than DCTCP, Vegas and IA-TCP.

articleTitle: A Flow Battery-based Energy-Storage System Integrated into a Wind Power-Generation System
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: The target of this paper is to explore the strategy for power integration of a vanadium redox flow battery (VRFB)-based energy-storage system (ESS) into a wind turbine system (WTS) supplying DC loads, and to obtain the best integration-management scheme for green-energy applications. The power-variation compensation characteristics among the VRFB-based ESS, the DC load, and the WTS are also evaluated.

articleTitle: A Deep Research on Stress Classification of Table Tennis Athletes Based on Perceived Stress Scale and EEG
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Stress for athletes may influence competition performance, and electroencephalography (EEG) is usually used as one of the approaches to stress classification. This study involves three phases: collection of EEG signals; pre-processing of EEG signals; and analysis of EEG signals. The collection of EEG signals phase uses the perceived stress scale and EEG to collect the brainwave data of table tennis athletes. The pre-processing of EEG signals phase uses the Butterworth filter and fast Fourier transform to process brainwave data. The analysis of EEG signals phase constructs the machine learning and deep learning models to analyze brainwave data. This study constructs the capsule networks (CapsNet) model of the accuracy of 2-level stress and 3-level stress at 96.91% and 96.91%. Finally, the results of model prediction provide information to the coaches and athletes that can prevent and reduce stress in advance.

articleTitle: ADAS E-Bike: Auxiliary ADAS Module For Electric Power-assisted Bicycle
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Protecting vehicle occupants and others involved in road traffic has become critical due to complex traffic rules and the increase in the number of vehicles on the road. While the technology is quite mature, there is still a need for power efficiency and improved road safety. In this paper, we proposed Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) module based on AI neural networks. The proposed algorithm evaluates road information, and various warning systems can be added to the body frame, such as a braking module, LED warning module, and vibration module. To improve power efficiency, we will use an embedded platform that requires a few watts of power to operate. The AI neural network-based ADAS would be implemented on an embedded platform.

articleTitle: Grid-Forming Inverter Control for Power Sharing Simulation in Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: For the operation of the microgrid system, it must de-energize from utility grid when the system meets fault conditions due to the safety and stability reasons. Meanwhile, it also need to guarantee continued power supply for the remaining facilities in microgrid. To achieve this operation task, inverters with grid-forming control are considered as mature solutions in recent years. In this paper, a microgrid system with a 30kVA and a 5kVA grid-forming inverters that integrated in two energy storage systems are modelling and the droop control with virtual impedances are designed for the inverters to operate in off-grid state. MATLAB/Simulink is implemented to carry out the power sharing simulation for the validation of the performance of proposed microgrid and grid-forming inverters models.

articleTitle: Determining the driver’s mental state using detecting the eyes
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Driver’s mental detection is an important work to avoid car accidents. In this paper, we want to use eye detection to understand the driver status from changes in the eyes. Whether you are tired or unfocused while driving, you can use face detection to judge and send warnings. This paper wants to use a facial marking blink counter and detection. The system uses OpenCV of Python modules and dlib of the driver. The testing of an instant eye blink detector will use the eye aspect ratio (EAR) to count the number of blinks of the driver and judge the driver’s focus state.

articleTitle: TripleNet: A Low-Parameter Network for Low Computing Power Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Deep learning has achieved great success in computer vision (CV), and convolutional neural networks (CNN) have become an important network architecture for CV tasks. With the widespread use of mobile devices, neural network models based on low-computing power platforms have received much attention. This paper proposes a lightweight CNN model named TripleNet. TripleNet learns the model compression methods of HarDNet and ThreshNet and improves on them. TripleNet completes the network architecture by combining three different convolutional layers, which has the advantages of small model size and high test accuracy. With similar test accuracy, TripleNet model has fewer parameters than HarDNet and ThreshNet. This paper conducts image classification experiments using TripleNet and other networks on CIFAR-10 and SVHN datasets. The experimental results show that compared with HarDNet, the parameters of TripleNet are reduced by 66% and the accuracy rate is improved by 18%; compared with ThreshNet, the parameters of TripleNet are reduced by 37% and the accuracy rate is improved by 5%.

articleTitle: Wide Range Output Voltage LLC Resonant Converter for Electric Vehicle Charging System
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: This paper presents the hybrid control of a fullbridge LLC series resonant converter as the application of an electric vehicle charging system. the hybrid control combines three control methods to achieve wide a output voltage range of about $75\sim 475 V$, three control methods including the pulse-frequency control method, phase-shift control method, and burst mode. finally, a wide-range output voltage LLC resonant converter prototype is realized. The specification of the prototype is a DC input voltage of SOO V, an output voltage of 75-475V, and maximum output power of 7.5 kW. The peak efficiency is 97.2 %.

articleTitle: Comparative MPPT Performance in a PV System Using Different Neural Network Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In this paper, both feedforward neural network (FFNN) and adaptive network-based fuzzy inference system (ANFIS) are proposed to maximize the output power of a PV system with maximum power point tracking (MPPT) function in the DC-DC boost converter fed to a DC load. The proposed schemes are trained using practical irradiance and temperature data of a PV system. The performances of the proposed schemes are also compared with the one using traditional perturbation and observation (P&O) method. From the simulation outcomes, the MPPT performances of the studied PV system using the proposed FFNN and ANFIS are better than one using traditional P&O method.

articleTitle: Systematic and Flexible Genetic-Algorithm-Based Feature Reduction for Decision Tree ML-Validation
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a systematic genetic-algorithm-based feature reduction method. It has a high design flexibility based on 5-tuple parameter adjustment. The users can decide these 5 parameters to satisfy the demands of making the focus on accuracy or reduced feature amount. The proposed algorithm is verified by decision-tree models with different data sets. As for the data set, ala, the number of features is reduced from 123 to 53 while the accuracy performance has an increase of 4.2%. In addition, for other data sets, the maximum accuracy loss is no more than 3.1% while the feature reduction ratio achieves 41.9%. Its advantage is to provide a design trade-off between accuracy and reduced feature amount.

articleTitle: Multicultural Knowledge and Information Literacy Learning Using AIoT Integration Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: This study uses AIoT combined with virtual-real integration technology to explore the cultural knowledge and information literacy learning of Indigenous people. In this era when few cultures need to be valued and preserved, this study uses virtual reality technology to turn the preservation of cultures into digitalization, so that complete objects can be preserved more safely and completely. The virtual reality space is used to further promote cultural and information literacy education. Learning through games, guided tours and teaching can strengthen the identity of one’s own culture and promote the cultural assets of some ethnic minorities. This research uses a broad range of Indigenous ethnic groups as an introduction to understanding, and then goes deep into other related cultures, celebrations, and festivals as secondary promotions, inspects or observes ethnic-related architectural structures, totems, pottery and other cultural relics, and at the same time achieves digital preservation and Provision of educational resources. This research also uses 3D printing technology to print and reproduce cultural objects to help learners strengthen their cultural understanding and identification concepts while learning new technologies.

articleTitle: Using Modified YOLOv4 for Military Target Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: We propose methods for object detection based on remote sensing images. This method further improves detection accuracy and decreases error rates. Modified YOLOv4 is an accelerated neural network model based on the YOLO (YouOnly-Look-Once) object detection method. It outperforms existing networks in terms of execution time and detection performance. The experimental results show improved mAP (mean average precision) performance of the proposed method for object detection in remote sensing images. We thus propose a novel system for automatic object detection for high-resolution remote sensing images.

articleTitle: Design of a Household Consumption based Water Leak Detection System Utilizing Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Water is a limited resource; thus, every drop matters. Leaks in water distribution networks (WDNs) and residences contribute considerably to water utility losses. The goal of this research is to design and build a water leak-detecting system based on home use. Based on historical water consumption and experimental flow rate water consumption data, this research developed a Bidirectional LSTM (BiLSTM) machine learning (ML) approach for building a water leakage detection model. The BiLSTM model is compared against Gated recurrent units (GRU) and Autoregressive models on the following performance metrics: mean squared error (MSE), root mean squared error (RMSE), mean absolute percentage error (MAPE), and mean absolute error (MAE) (MAE). According to the data, the BiLSTM model performed better overall in water leak detection.

articleTitle: Using GAN Augment CNN performance in Acute Leukemia Classification
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) is a type of artificial neural network and deep learning used to synthesize images. In recent years, many studies have applied GAN in the field of medical imaging. This study uses Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) to predict the classification of acute leukemia and compares the accuracy of CNN model classification prediction before and after the use of GAN data proliferation. After using the original data to generate images with 8 different parameter combinations, twodimensional images using CD3 and CD7 were used to obtain a classification accuracy of 77.4% without GAN data proliferation. Following GAN data proliferation to add images for which the original data were insufficient, CNN classification prediction accuracy increased to 84.7%. This indicates that using GAN to fill gaps for medical diagnostic data can effectively provide the large volume of data required for CNN model training.

articleTitle: An Efficient Single Image Fog Removal using Improved Dark Channel Prior
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Fog removal is one of the most challenging problem in image processing. In the most scenes, using dark channel prior (DCP) for single image fog removal achieves good results. However, DCP itself has weakness to poorly suffer scenes having extreme light source. We propose an improved single image fog removal algorithm that based on DCP algorithm-a very popular single image fog removal algorithm. As a result, the proposed method can improve the fog removal effectiveness up to 19.7%, which enhances the vision of camera system application.

articleTitle: Design Flow for The Implementation of Obfuscated Finite State Machines
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Hardware obfuscation is a useful technique for IP (intellectual property) protection. Several previous works have paid attention to the design of obfuscated FSM (finite state machine). Their common way is to insert an extra obfuscation mode to prevent the attackers from entering the normal mode. Based on the concept of obfuscation mode, in this paper, we study the design flow for FPGA implementation. The proposed design flow includes two main steps: RTL coding (for the obfuscation mode) followed by FPGA synthesis. Experiments with a real circuit show that the FPGA implementation can work without any degradation on circuit speed.

articleTitle: An Environmental Sensing and APP Display System Based on IoT
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: This research develops a cheap and multi-functional environment sensing and APP display system. The sensing end of this system is composed of CO2 sensor, PM2.5 sensor, GPS module, memory module, microprocessor, Bluetooth,,,,,etc.. The sensed information can be stored in the memory module, and then use computer and mobile phone to observe the curve of data changes, and proceed further analyze, discuss, and decision-making. This research mainly writes a mobile APP program, uses Bluetooth to control the sensor memory module data, and then displays them on the mobile phone. The values sensed by various sensors can be observed from the mobile phone screen, and the changing curve can be present. In addition, it can also display the sensing time and location of a sensing value in map mode, so that the complete sensing data information can be clearly understood from the mobile phone.

articleTitle: AlN Passivation Technique for Ultra-Thin Barrier GaN Power Devices Demonstrating High Output Current and Low Current Degradation
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: For the first time, we introduce an effective passivation technique for ultra-thin AlGaN barrier metal-insulator-semiconductor high electron-mobility transistors (MIS-HEMTs). Three different ultra-thin barrier structures were carried out to be compared for the device characteristics. The MOCVD-ALN passivated device demonstrated a high maximum drain current of 1002 mA/mm, low on-state resistance of 7.2 Ω.mm, and low current degradation, showing great potential for future power device applications.

articleTitle: Study on surface-enhanced Raman scattering performance of pitted GaN covered by Au layer
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Rough surface with micro-nano pits can form large numbers of hot spots after noble metal deposition, which would be beneficial to improve surface enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) signal. In this study, we proposed a SERS substrate that GaN was etched by KOH and then covered by Au layer. Scanning electronic microscopy confirmed the thicknesses of Au layers and revealed many typical hexagonal micro-nano pits distributing on the surface. SERS results indicate the pitted GaN covered by the Au layer of 25 nm has best SERS intensity in our case, providing a good enhancement factor of 6. 57$\times 10^{7}$ and a limit of detection of approximately 1$0^{-9}$M for rhodamine 6G(R6G) used as a test molecule because of the electromagnetic mechanism at the interface between Au layers and R6G. A series of experiments demonstrate $\mathrm{A}\mathrm{u}/$pitted $\mathrm{G}\mathrm{a}\mathrm{N}$ with high sensitivity is potential for biomedical application.

articleTitle: Fast Intra Coding Algorithm Based on Visual Perception Analysis for H.266/VVC
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: H.266/Versatile Video Coding (VVC) is the latest international video coding standard to support high-definition video with resolutions from 4K to 8K and beyond. The compression ratio is higher than that of H.265/High Efficiency Video Coding (H.265/HEVC). In addition to the quad-tree partition structure in H.265/HEVC, the multi-type-tree (MTT) structure consisting of the binary tree and the ternary tree provides more diverse splits in H.266/VVC. It is also equipped with many new coding tools, which greatly increases the encoding time. This paper proposes a fast H.266/VVC intra coding algorithm based on visual perception analysis. According to the just-noticeable-difference in visual perception, the visually distinguishable pixels are extracted. Two intra coding tools are turned off conditionally. By using random forest classifiers of machine learning, the fast horizontal/vertical splitting decisions for the binary tree and the ternary tree are proposed. Under the All-Intra configuration, the experimental results show the proposed algorithm can save the encoding time by 47.51% with a BDBR of 1.454% on average. The proposed algorithm outperforms the previous research.

articleTitle: Applications of Cancer Classification Using Elman Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: This paper presents an Elman neural network (ENN) approach using biogeography-based optimization (BBO) algorithm augmented with classification rate for the breast cancer and lung cancer classification applications. In order to investigate the efficiencies of BBO method, real-time recurrent learning (RTRL), genetic algorithm (GA), and particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm are also implemented for comparison. The mean square error (MSE), standard deviation (SD), and classification rate are conducted and compared to demonstrate the classification performances.

articleTitle: All inorganic HTL/ETL Perovskite solar cells
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: The stability and lifetime of Perovskite solar cells (PSCs) are still the biggest challenges in this field of solar energy. In this study, the all-inorganic electron/hole transport layer PSCs were developed to replace the traditional PSCs structure. The efficiency of all inorganic HTL/ETL PSCs achieve 16.3%. Under 0.8 sun illumination and 60°C. accelerated aging test, all-inorganic ETL/HTL PSCs start to drop after 1400 hrs compared to traditional PSCs, which drop after 24 hrs.

articleTitle: Facial Expression Recognition Based on Snaking Data Access and Pipeline Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed facial expression recognition based on snaking data access and pipeline convolution neural network. This paper performs an expression recognition system composed of fast convolution operations. We use Winograd algorithm to reduce the number of multipliers and design data reuse, pipeline and Snaking data access structures to increase the performance of the chip. Therefore, the chip can perform high-speed computing and achieve a well facial expression recognition rate.

articleTitle: VLSI Architecture of Low-Cost High-Order Matched Filter Using 8-Phase Switching Paths for Undersea Object-Identification Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a low-cost VLSI hardware architecture of matched filter design, especially for the demand of high-order taps. We make a good use of hardware-sharing principle and utilize 8-phase switching paths. The application includes object identification required in the undersea-exploring environment. A 64-tap matched filter hardware is designed via TSMC 40-nm CMOS technology and well-verified with respect to a usual transposed form work. In area comparison, our proposed work only occupies 0.04 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and saves 74.8% of synthesis area. In addition, our proposed circuit is implemented only with a total core area of 0.29 x0.29mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> in layout while input data and weight coefficients have wordlength of 10 and 18 bits, respectively.

articleTitle: A Programmable Pressure Cuff at Fingertip to Aid Sepsis Detection in Intensive Care Unit
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Sepsis is an infectious disease with a very high fatality rate. In Taiwan, the fatality rate is as high as nearly 30%. Sepsis is also known as the “silent killer” due to its vague symptoms difficult to be discerned. Therefore, early detection of sepsis is highly desired. Its systemic inflammation may cause thrombosis and reduce the peripheral blood flow. By delivering a standardized pressure at the fingertip, the blood refill time can be used to detect the reduction of blood flow, which is an indicator of potential sepsis. In this preliminary study we designed a programmable light pressure cuff applicable to the same fingertip when the finger probe of pulse oximetry is also worn. Its functionality and durability were validated. Eventually the inexpensive device can be applied to each patient in the ICU to monitor sepsis from real-time pulse signal analysis under a cloud-computing architecture.

articleTitle: Low-Voltage Ride Through Capability Test by IEC 61400-27-1 Wind Turbine Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: With the increasing installations of wind power generations, issues associate with the operation of power system integrates with wind turbines cannot be underestimated. Currently, to maintain high efficient operation of power system, the functionality of low-voltage ride through (LVRT) are expected to be included in wind turbine (WT) by utility grid so as to support grid recovery when meet fault events. In this paper, the generic phasor modeling of Type-3 double-fed wind turbine based on IEC 61400-27-1:2020 is first investigated; then the LVRT control is designed in WT model for voltage compensation. MATLAB/Simulink is employed in this paper for modeling, simulation analysis, and the performance validation of the studied WT model and control.

articleTitle: Impact of control strategies on altitude control in indoor quadcopter
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: The indoor quadcopter is widely adopted because of its properties of maneuverability, mechanical simplicity, and excellent research platforms to perform control strategies. In this study, impact of several control strategies on altitude control has been provided with classic ZN PID, Fuzzy-based, and GA-based controllers. The buildin nonlinear mathematical model of Parrot Mambo Minidrone is adopted as the control models for the design and deployment in this study. According to the control models, a set of parameters of classic ZN PID controller is obtained as a baseline strategy. Fine-tuned parameters of classic PID are simulated to observe the altitude performance. A Fuzzy-based controller with proper fuzzy sets is also provided to examine the performance. Eventually, an empirical GA-based controller is developed to be compared with other control strategies. The results show that the GA-based controller performed the smallest integral of absolute error of altitude performance and demonstrated averagely 87% improvement of overall altitude error as compared with the baseline controller.

articleTitle: The Study of Adding Anti-Solvent to Improve the Efficiency of Perovskite Solar Cells
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Perovskite solar cells (PSCs) possess the advantages of low cost and high conversion efficiency. PSCs can be stacked with silicon solar cells by tuning the band gap to form high-efficiency tandem solar cells. In this study, an anti-solvent was added to enhance the grain growth of the perovskite absorber layer and to improve the crystal quality and carrier transport. As a result, the efficiency of PSCs device adding antisolvent is 18.17% compares to those without adding anti-solvent is 16.31%, an increase of11.4%.

articleTitle: Design of a High-Resolution Video Reconstruction and Transcoding System based on Super-Resolution GAN
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: With the popularization of high-definition video devices, more and more users and video streaming service providers desire to restore early classic videos and deliver classic video contents with improved resolution. However, existing video transcoding systems do not support super-resolution video reconstruction. A high-resolution video reconstruction and transcoding system design based on super-resolution image generative adversarial network (GAN) is proposed to perform super-resolution video reconstruction for low resolution videos and then transcode videos with different resolutions to meet the playback requirements of heterogeneous mobile devices in order to provide users with good video viewing quality. Users can have good video viewing quality with the proposed system even in the absence of the original high-resolution videos.

articleTitle: Movable Wireless Charging System for Multiple Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: This paper discusses the design of wireless induction charging and radar to identify power receiving place, image identification, and adjustment position for vehicles. The research idea came from EVs as well as the increasingly mature wireless charging technology in recent years. This paper analyzes the possibility of using the radar system combined with image recognition to solve the problems when vehicles are currently charged at fixed positions. Vehicles sometimes cannot be accurately aligned with the power transmission board, resulting in poor efficiency, or there is insufficient power transmission board due to locations. This paper provides solutions to improve charging efficiency, using radar as a sensor in design to find the position of the vehicle and position it below the power receiving place. The image recognition module PIXY 2 is also employed to capture the image color to adjust a more accurate position, so that the charging efficiency and speed can be improved and that time and space limitation can be avoided.

articleTitle: Study of Silicon Nitride Etched by Cyclic Atomic Layer Etching
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In this work, cyclic atomic layer etching (ALE) was used to etch silicon nitride (SiN) to find its working conditions. To understand the mechanism behind it, we tested the ALE adsorption effect and the removal effect of the ALE working window. Also, we made a comparison with the etching RMS of normal etching ICP and showed that ALE has better etch flatness. This demonstrates that ALE has a potential ability to become a reliable and stable etching technology in the future.

articleTitle: Multi-field application of automatic intruder warning and eviction systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: A novel low cost PTZ camera for intruder warning and eviction systems is presented using ResNet model to plan the best path of patrol, YoloV5 detect intruders and allow them to be tracked at eye level. The loudspeaker disperses with different sound system depending on the type of intruder and send the intruder image and dispersion result to LINE (Apps) to the manager. And then tested on the Edge Computing platform to achieve real time performance (30 FPS) with the minimum accuracy of 92%.

articleTitle: A Fast Kernel Least Mean Square Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: To deal with the problems in the nonlinear system, the kernel adaptive filter (KAF) was proposed by processing data in the reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS). However, the kernel method dramatically improves the amount of calculation of the filter, which limits its application in practical problems. Furthermore, a critical factor in a large amount of KAF computation is due to its slow convergence speed, which requires a large amount of training data to participate in the calculation. If we can accelerate the convergence speed of KAF, the amount of training data can be reduced, thereby reducing the amount of KAF computation. This paper proposes a fast kernel least mean square algorithm (FAST-KLMS) by adaptively updating step size to address this issue. To verify the superiority of FAST-KLMS, we have applied it to the simulations of nonlinear channel equalization. The simulation results show that FAST-KLMS needs less training data to complete the convergence, which has improved the filtering performance of KAF.

articleTitle: Duplexing Antenna Design Using Substrate Integrated Waveguide Cavity with Bi-Direction Radiation Pattern
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: We proposed a compact co-design of duplexing antenna which consist of two monopole antennas and a substrate-integrated waveguide cavity (SIWC). Two monopole antennas are integrated with one SIWC diplexer with the latter hosting the former two. The SIWC’s broad side wall serves as the antenna ground. The excitations of two monopole antennas are in a 180° phase difference which leads to a bi-directional radiation pattern. The integration of the SIWC diplexer and the antennas not only duplexes the transmitting and receiving signals, but also enhances the antenna’s signal selectivity and circuit compactness. Experiments are conducted and the measured and simulated data are in good agreement.

articleTitle: Wireless Human Recognization Design in Indoor Enviroment
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Wireless human location reorganization is regarded as an interesting field in smart home applications. This paper develops a radio frequency identification (RFID)-based human location navigation and recognition in the complicated indoor environments. At least three active RFID tags and their related response of the strength readers, i.e. received signal strength (RSS) through a wireless routing station are proposed to indicate the human position. A personalized indoor space information is collected in the design software to predict the moving trace of people. A wireless windows application for human recognition is designed to real-time detect their dynamic location in indoor space. Several experiments are applied to demonstrate an excellent utility to approach our design purpose.

articleTitle: Tunable Step Impedance Filter with Plasma Coupling
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Filters are important component in many microwave circuit, and step impedance filter (SIF) is compact and well developed. In this article we investigate the performance of SIF if part of it is covered with plasma instead of air. Because the dielectric constant of plasma is different than air and is partially tunable, this design turns SIF into a partially tunable filter. The simulation results show a low pass SIF changes into band pass filter with several valleys after plasma coupling.

articleTitle: NPK Prediction based on pH Colorimetry Utilizing ResNet for Fertilizer Recommender System
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In the agricultural sector of the Philippines, the most pressing problem farmers are facing is the scarcity of soil analysis. Soil analysis plays a vital role in ensuring maximum yield and plant growth. Soil pH and the primary macronutrients are the salient soil parameters to consider. Primary macronutrients refer to the soil’s Nitrogen (N), Phosphorus (P), and Potassium (K) content. Also, soil pH is the primary soil variable affecting the macronutrients. The right amount of fertilizer can be derived from the soil parameters to replenish the lost macronutrients. This study proposed a Residual Neural Network (ResNet) model to predict the primary soil macronutrients based on soil pH colorimetry for the fertilizer recommender system. The performance of the ResNet method was evaluated and compared to Restricted Boltzmann Neural Network (RBNN) and Deep Neural Network (DNN) by the following performance metrics: R-squared, Relative Absolute Error, CPU usage, memory usage (MiB), and loading time (sec). Based on the evaluated results, ResNet performed better in primary macronutrient prediction. The proposed ResNet model was successfully implemented in the fertilizer recommender system.

articleTitle: The refractive index measurement of seawater based on a photo array sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In this study, an improved sensor for measuring the refractive index of seawater is proposed, and the refractive index of seawater is defined by the displacement of the laser spot in the photo array sensor. In the small variations of seawater refractive index, the proposed refractive index sensor is simple and low-cost. The measurement of salinity in seawater has always been an important issue in marine science, especially in aquaculture and acoustic applications. In aquaculture, salinity will directly affect the living conditions of aquatic products. In acoustic applications, salinity affects the speed at which sound travels in the sea. Therefore, accurate measurement of seawater salinity is an important topic in marine science.

articleTitle: Frequency Control of a Bidirectional Interlinking Converter in an Islanded Hybrid AC/DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: This paper proposes a bidirectional virtual inertial control (BVIC) strategy for an islanded hybrid AC/DC microgrid (MG) including two renewable-energy power-generation systems and an energy-storage system (ESS). The studied hybrid AC/DC MG consists of a wind farm, a PV farm, a bidirectional DC-DC converter, and a bidirectional interlinking converter (BIC). The vanadium redox flow battery (VRFB)-based ESS is connected to the DC MG through a bidirectional DC-DC converter, while the DC MG is connected to the AC MG through the BIC. On the basis of the virtual synchronous generator, this paper uses the BVIC strategy based on BIC to achieve power distribution between the DC and AC MGs, suppress the deviations of both DC-link voltage and frequency of the AC side, and compare the differences for the studied system with and without the BVIC. The steady-state frequency-domain analysis of the studied system under different operating conditions is performed. Both dynamic and transient time-domain simulations of the studied system under various disturbance conditions are also carried out.

articleTitle: A Conditional Generative Adversarial Network Method for Image Segmentation in Blurry Image
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Nowadays, the wide application of machine vision is developing rapidly, and image segmentation is indeed one of the indispensable technologies. When the input image is blurred, the outline of the target object will be unclear, resulting in inaccurate segmentation. This paper proposes an image segmentation method based on Generative Adversarial Network, combined with Concatentation and Summation to enhance the encoder and decoder and improve these problems without preprocessing data. This paper uses two experimental methods to verify the final image segmentation effect. It uses the Intersection over Union (IoU) score as the evaluation metric. The number of low IoU in this model does not increase drastically with the degree of blur. Moreover, without an overfitting issue in the testing dataset. It can prove the universality of the model.

articleTitle: The Use of Virtual Idol in Sports Communication: The Example of Table Tennis Competition Broadcasting in the National University and College Athletic Games
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: VTuber is a virtual idol created by combining virtual technology and YouTuber, and using a physical motion capture system to manipulate the virtual idol with real movements, making it interactive and real-time, allowing the main audience and minority otaku to have an immersive emotional experience.In the past, attempts to combine virtual idols with journalism have often been time-consuming and costly. The Department of Radio and Television at Ming Chuan University has been in charge of broadcasting table tennis games for the National University and College Athletic Games for two years since 2021 and has a good understanding of the workflow. Therefore, on this basis, this thesis aims to clearly explain, through the preparation of pre-production, completed the integration of virtual idol and TV news video production in less than two hours with the operation of two to three people.

articleTitle: Investigation of p-GaN Gate HEMT using Removal Si Substrate and part of Buffer Layer
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Normally-off p-GaN gate high electron mobility transistor (HEMT) on Si substrate using the back-side via process was investigated. We removed the Si substrate and part of the GaN carbon-doped layer. A 100 nm thickness of SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> layer is deposited on the back-side via to obstruct the buffer leakage, and a 1um thick gold is electroplated to improve the self-heating effect. With and without the backside via process, the threshold voltages are 0.92 and 1.45 V, the on/off drain current ratios are 5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sup> and 5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup>, the subthreshold swings are 154 and 224 mV/dec, the static on-resistances are 24.77 and 27.55 Ω.mm, and the dynamic on-resistance ratios are 1.18 and 1.3.

articleTitle: An improved method for measuring small-angle variation based on phase-enhanced total-internal-reflection heterodyne interferometry
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: This research presents an improved method to measure small-angle variation using the phase-enhanced total-internal-reflection (TIR) heterodyne interferometric approach. In the method, a small angular variation can be estimated with measuring a change of the difference in phase between two orthogonal polarizations of a totally-reflected ray from a phase-enhanced TIR apparatus. The method yielded the measurement sensitivity and errors exceeding to $130(0^{\circ}/\circ)$ and $ 2\times 10^{-4}\circ$ within the extent of 0.3°.

articleTitle: Energy-efficient and Accurate Object Detection Design on an FPGA Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: With the innovation of hardware equipment, the development of artificial intelligence has broken through the limitations of the past. Neural networks have been continuously deepened to improve the accuracy of detection, so that the parameters have increased with a direct proportional rate. In this way, however, high energy consumption has been induced which obstacles the deployment of AI algorithms on portable devices. Therefore, the design of neural network must consider not only detection accuracy but also energy efficiency. In this paper, we analyzed energy consumption, detection accuracy and execution speed of our neural network model as well as the state-of-the-art models based on an FPGA platform called ZCU-102. We adopt the performance index from Low Power Computer Vision (LPCV) challenge which considers power dissipation, mean Average Precision (mAP) and Frames Per Second (FPS) at the same time to evaluate these models in an overall point of view. Agilev4 can achieve 59.9% of mAP@50 on MS COCO test-dev2017 datasets. If the input frame resolution is turned into $416\times 416$, the processing frame rate can reach 20.7 FPS on ZCU-102. Compared with the state-of-the-art models, the LPCV score of Agilev4-416 is 1475. S which is 1.56 times of that of YOLOv4-416.

articleTitle: Performance-Improved AdaBoost with Parameterized and Simple-Operation Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a design methodology for the AdaBoost with parameterized genetic algorithm (PGA) to improve the accuracy performance. It can provide 3 parameters to arbitrarily adjust. In addition, we develop the low-computing operations for crossover and mutation tasks, the essential processing in GA. In the performance analysis, our 6classifier AdaBoost with PGA method outperforms 10-classifier AdaBoost in terms of accuracy. While the number of classifiers survived is 2, 3, and 4, the according accuracy has a maximum increase of 5.74%, 7.65%, and 8.81%, respectively. Its benefits include a smaller number of classifiers required and accuracy increase.

articleTitle: ESD-immunity Study of High-voltage nLDMOS with Vertical Parasitic Schottky Structures in the Source End
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In this paper, a TSMC $0.18- {\mu} \mathrm{m}$ BCD process is used to realize high-voltage n-LDMOS devices. And then, the source side $n^{{+}}$ layer of the reference device is removed, so that the source terminal will make a parasitic Schottky device. Next, in this paper, we will evaluate its impacts on the discharge current capability. There are four kinds of tested devices in this work, which are the reference, with whole source -Schottky MM, and removed half source electrode MN and maked half Schottky in source end NM type devices, respectively. According to the TLP testing results, three important values of snapback curve can be obtained: trigger voltage (${\mathrm{V}}_{{\mathrm t1}}$), holding voltage (${\mathrm{V}}_{{\mathrm{h}}}$), and secondary breakdown current (${\mathrm{I}}_{{\mathrm{t}}2}$). Finally, it can be concluded that if a Schottky device is added to the source terminal, the on-resistance will be increased due to the series connection of this Schottky device, then the trigger voltage can be increased about 2V and holding voltage increased about 8V.

articleTitle: 2D Winograd Circuits with Data Reuse for FaceNet Identification System
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed 2D Winograd circuits with data reuse for FaceNet identification system. We optimize the FaceNet network and use the CASIA-WebFace database. In order to improve the computing efficiency of the system, we combined fast 2D Winograd algorithms for convolutional neural networks to optimize the operation of the convolution circuit, and increase the data reading performance through data reuse. Compared with the traditional FFT convolution operation, it can reduce 2.25 operational complexity.

articleTitle: Automatic Lung Cancer Segmantation based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Recently, the number of people diagnosed with lung cancer in Taiwan has gradually increased. In particular, the proportion of lung adenocarcinoma is the highest among lung cancers. Although there are many ways to find the location of the tumor, the only way to determine whether the tumor is benign or malignant can only be determined by pathological examination. Only then can we know that to avoid insufficient medical energy, this study uses image segmentation to help medical laboratory technicians quickly determine the location of tumors, which can not only stabilize medical energy, but also use artificial intelligence to assist medical laboratory students to use computers to study.

articleTitle: A Friendly Vision Enhancement System Prototype Development for Text Content
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: This paper proposes a system that helps users to enhance their reading ability. A reading enhancement system has been developed based on image capture, image processing, segmentation, and pattern recognition. This system not only provides a better user experience than using a telescope or just a smartphone but also facilitates efficient reading.
