The result of this paper has been validated in the classroom and laboratory. In the future, researchers can use this system to study the user experience of glasses or help disabled people to get better learning results.

articleTitle: Multi-Vital Signs System with Sensor Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: This paper proposes a scheme with sensor fusion that enhances a traditional multi-vital signs system’s performance by predicting the user’s physiological state. Detecting the user’s carbon dioxide, temperature, and humidity produced by breathing can effectively estimate whether the user has enough resting-state time before conducting measurements. Additionally, when users are not using the system, it can monitor ambient parameters, such as carbon dioxide, temperature, and humidity. More importantly, it can collect the user’s physiological state to achieve the higher performance of an intelligent multi-vital signs system.

articleTitle: Biomimetic Functional Surface as Anti-corrosion Coating Layers
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: The present work focuses on developing a biomimetic anti-corrosion coating layers for cold-rolled steels (CRSs). The surface structures of Oreochromis mossambicus fish scales is chosen to be the biological source being mimicked. Prior to using, the chemical treatment condition in order to remove the remained contaminant and flesh to expose surface structures is optimized according to water contact angle (WCA) performance. By applying soft lithography technique along with secondary transferring skill, the bio-inspired functional surface structures is successfully transferred to the blank protection coatings of CRSs with similar surface structure and slightly better hydrophobicity. The Electrochemical results reveal 6.5% and 65% improvement versus blank coating CRS samples in corrosion potential and corrosion current respectively.

articleTitle: Lightweight architecture for face recognition system
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In view of the current world market demand, “Face ID Recognition System” has developed to the highest level. In “Facial Recognition” field, the applications used are generally similar. Now the only thing we can change is how to adjust image resolution and how to speed up image processing. This paper adopts the existing rapid identification system architecture of “Paddle Paddle”. It is an open source deep learning framework platform developed by Baidu. It contains a lot about lightweight architecture and lightweight networking. The “PP-Sin Tu” architecture is one of the lightweight identifications in “Paddle Paddle”. It can use a few data to achieve the identification effect. The fast identification system and the accuracy of the identification effect, both performances are excellent, It’s just that this architecture is not used for face recognition. Therefore, this paper wants to create a system that can quickly identify and achieved real-time identity by using a few identity data.

articleTitle: Occluded Retail Products Detection Through Attention-Reweighted
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In recent years, developments in artificial intelligence (AI) and computer vision (CV) have led to an increase in research regarding retail product detection. However, effective CV use for identifying objects continues to face major obstacles, such as customers% random placement of products at checkout partially obscuring items from view. This paper explores the use of faster region-based convolutional neural networks (Faster RCNN) and attentional reweighting to detect obscured retail products. This attention-based method allows CV to identify and process various occlusion patterns. While the training set used to teach the network excluded heavily occluded data, the test set included a range of obscuration levels to accurately reflect the random positioning of products in real life. Experimental results suggest that the proposed method returns better detection accuracy with occlusion problems than current approaches employing convolutional neural networks (CNNs).

articleTitle: Development of road environment identification system using YOLO V5
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: The detection and recognition of road traffic environment is a key technology for smart cars, and it is also an important task of environmental perception in the vehicle’s automatic driving system. It is the basis for the subsequent path planning, decision-making and control of the vehicle. As the advancement of autonomous driving technology is becoming more and more mature, advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) systems can complete partial semi-autonomous driving with human assistance, such as automatic cruise system (ACC), when fully autonomous driving technology has not yet been completed. The completion of fully autonomous driving technology is extremely important for road environment recognition. Therefore, this study uses the object detection technology YOLO V5 algorithm as the road environment identification. In the research, it is divided into two parts, the first part is the part of road environment image training, which mainly deals with image processing, establishing database and generating weight files for testing. The second part is the test system. When the specified image or image is input into the road detection system, data processing and identification are performed, and the identification result is labeled and output. The research results show that objects in the road environment can be marked through the YOLO V5 system as road environment recognition.

articleTitle: COVID-19 Lung CT Images Recognition with Superscalar Winograd Circuit Based on VGG19
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed COVID-19 lung CT (computed tomography) images recognition with superscalar winograd circuit based on VGG19. We adopt the VGG-19 machine learning architecture to recognize lung CT images and speed up neural network operations through Superscalar Winograd Circuit. After a series of experiments, our proposed method has a high pneumonia recognition rate and high computational efficiency.

articleTitle: A Design of Relaxation Oscillator with Pulse Width Modulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: This paper proposes a relaxation oscillator with pulse width modulation. With the control of the digital controller, the relaxation oscillator has clock outputs with different duty cycles. With the analog supply is 1.8V, the proposed circuit support the output frequency of 24.56 MHz when the duty cycle is 50%, and the power is about 114.1 $\mu$ W. In addition to 50%, the duty cycle of the output can also support the duty cycle of 20% and 80%, and the variation of the output frequency can be within 6%.

articleTitle: Bilingual Fake News Detection Algorithm Using Naïve Bayes and Support Vector Machine Models
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: This study aims to mitigate the absorption of fraudulent news by exploring the feasibility of using Naive Bayes and SGD classifier models in predicting whether the English or Filipino article is real or fake. This is accomplished by training the models through large pre-processed datasets. After evaluation, both models have achieved an accuracy of 93% and 95% accuracy respectively.

articleTitle: Image Recognition by YoloV4 for Vehicle Type Distinction in Side of Road
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: At present, most of the domestic and foreign research on vehicle recognition focuses on real-time camera recognition in front of the vehicle while driving and real-time camera recognition over the road for overhead camera angles. For roads in mountainous areas or special terrain, due to the small hinterland on the left and right side of the road, it is not easy to set up overhead camera systems for the road. Therefore, this thesis proposes “Yolo_v4-based road vehicle recognition” to solve the above problem. Unlike the overhead camera system, this side camera detachable temporary road vehicle recognition system only needs a very small road hinterland and can reduce the cost of space construction. The Yolo_V4 deep learning algorithm can accurately identify different vehicle types to ensure road safety and traffic monitoring. In this study, the accuracy of the vehicle recognition model for the side camera angle is 96%, which is comparable to the accuracy of the vehicle recognition model for the top camera angle.

articleTitle: A Face Mask Detection System Based on High Level Synthesis and Hardware Software Codesign
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: This paper presents an experimental trial of implementing a face mask detection system based on a high-level synthesis (HLS) design flow and the concept of hardware/ software codesign. The target platform is a low-cost Xilinx PYNQ-Z2 FPGA board, which is connected to a host computer and serves as a hardware accelerator performing the task of face mask detection. The development is under a PYNQ framework supporting applications, software and hardware designs. In applications, a Jupyter Notebook is used for system level control. In hardware design, a Vivado HLS IP flow is used to design the hardware computing kernel and implement the interface (overlay) between hardware and software sections. To simplify the hardware implementation complexity, the face mask detection algorithm adopts an ISP approach in lieu of complicated CNN models. The algorithm consists of color space transform, skin color detection, morphological operations, connected components labeling and horizontal edge detection. Despite its algorithmic simplicity, the proposed scheme supports multi-object detection and can exclude the interferences from non-face parts. Each module is described in C++ and translated to a corresponding hardware design module via HLS. These modules are then combined to form a hardware accelerator and integrated to the PYNQ framework. The implementation result indicates the detection FPS can reach 18.

articleTitle: Soft Sensing Measurement of Dissolved Ammonia Nitrogen in Tank-Based Eel Aquaculture Systems Utilizing Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Japanese eels are susceptible to low concentrations of dissolved ammonia nitrogen $(\mathrm{N}\mathrm{H}_{3}-\mathrm{N})$. To provide proper intervention, measuring the dissolved ammonia nitrogen in the tank-based eel aquaculture is crucial. However, existing laboratory methods and digital sensors are timeconsuming and expensive solutions. This study proposed an Attentive Interpretable Tabular Learning (TabNet) Deep Learning soft-sensing model to predict dissolved NH3-N concentrations. The prediction model is based on input parameters: water temperature, conductivity, pH, and dissolved oxygen. The datasets are gathered from the Global Environment Monitoring System (GEMStat), a water quality parameter database. The performance of the proposed Deep Learning model was compared with Feed-forward neural network (F-NN) and One Dimensional-CNN. The models were evaluated using statistical methods: R-squared (R2), Mean Absolute Error (MAE), and Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE). The simulation results showed that TabNet performed better in predicting dissolved NH3-N concentrations.

articleTitle: A Short-Term Spatiotemporal Wind Speed Forecasting Using CNN Optimized by PSO
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Since precise wind speed forecasts can be converted directly into accurate wind power predictions, wind speed forecasting is essential for the operation of power systems. A spatiotemporal wind speed prediction model based on the 2D Convolutional Neural Network (2D CNN) optimized by the Particle Swarm optimization (PSO) is proposed in this paper. In order for the 2D CNN to establish parameters adaptively, the hyperparameters (kernel size and length, dropout rate, and the number of input cells in the hidden layers) are optimized by PSO. Five wind speed datasets in Taiwan were used for this study. The results validate the applicability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: YOLO-R Based Mask Recognition System with Winograd Convolution Acceleration Chip
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed “YOLO-R based mask recognition system with Winograd convolution acceleration chip.” In order to prevent the spread of COVID-19, we proposed a mask recognition system based on YOLO-R that adopted the CSP backbone architecture and used prediction refinement to predict, optimize, and obtain high recognition results. In addition, we designed the Winograd convolution acceleration chip to accelerate the operation of the YOLO-R neural network, so that the system can achieve real-time computing.

articleTitle: One-hour Ahead Spatio-Temporal Solar GHI Forecasting Using Long Short-term Memory
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Using time-series information from surrounding sites, this paper explores the short-term forecasting of solar global horizontal irradiance (GHI) at a single target site. Long Short-term Memory (LSTM) is presented to forecast GHI, based on the integration of spatial and temporal information. Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is used to optimize the hyperparameter and time step in LSTM. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method is more accurate than existing methods for 1-hour ahead GHI forecasting.

articleTitle: Zero Payload Enhanced AES Cryptography Against Side-Channel Attacks
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: the development of side-channel attacks makes secrets visible due to the physical leakage of confidential operations. In order to prevent the crack of cryptography, various cost sensitive countermeasures of side channel attacks are also being developed. This paper proposes a zero payload deformative method, which can increase the resistant sidechannel attacks of Advanced Encryption Standard cryptography by 10 to 100 times. Whose payload is better than the currently known methods.

articleTitle: Energy Saving Potential Evaluation for U-V Connection Power System-Case Study in Taipower
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: There have always been many disagreements over applying open-wye open-delta transformer connection for supplying small business users. However, as the most commonly used power supply method for Taiwan’s $3\Phi 3\mathrm{W}220\mathrm{V}$ system, it is not without its advantages. There are more reasons for being stigmatized because of user misuse. This study intends to discuss this electric utility system from the point of view of energy saving, and try to propose improvement schemes.

articleTitle: Fabrication and Analysis of Thermoelectric Generator-Integrated Shoes for Hiking
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Hiking is a physical activity with many benefits. However, a health monitoring device is needed to avoid the possibility of illness or injury while hiking. Thermoelectric generator-integrated shoes can take advantage of the difference of temperature between a human foot and mountain land to generate electrical energy for the power needs of health monitoring devices. In the study, the initial design of thermoelectric generator-integrated shoes could generate electrical energy from the heat. Yet, further studies are needed to increase the output of voltage and power in the future.

articleTitle: Student Engagement Analysis Using Facial Expression in Online Course
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Due to the COVID-19 outbreak in recent years, long distance learning has been prevalent. The increasing need of online learning calls for the effectiveness of the learning evaluation method in digital learning through human-computer interaction (HCI) to be strengthened. Therefore, this study collects bigdata images through computer vision, collects data on the students’ emotional and behavioral dimensions under multidimensionality, and analyzes these data through deep learning (DL) with the student engagement model. This proposes an online student learning engagement analysis system based on biometrics image processing applied to artificial intelligence (AI). In the prediction of student participation, emotional and behavioral dimension data obtained from different students will be used to find out the weight relations between these two engagement dimensions and engagement value through the regression model of DL and evaluate participants’ engagement status in online learning.

articleTitle: Table of Contents Recognition using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: As far as modern technology is concerned, Optical Character Recognition (OCR) technology is becoming more and more stable. Electronic files are easier to store than paper files, do not take up too much space, and are less likely to suffer from data loss. However, the Document’s Table of Contents (TOC) provides the overall structure of the document, such as chapters and appendices. Therefore, TOC recognition can analyze OCR documents more efficiently. In this study, we developed a novel deep learning method based on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), and Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) to identify TOCs. Finally, the experimental results show that our proposed method outperforms other methods.

articleTitle: Intelligent Management System Design for Household Refrigerators
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In this study, the Raspberry Pi is used to detect the status of the refrigerator door and the food’s shelf life. When the refrigerator door is closed, the user is reminded to record the food information; when the food exceeded the shelf life, the user is reminded to deal with the relevant food as soon as possible. In addition to the notification function, it can also record the status of food entering and leaving the refrigerator according to the user, calculate the Reorder Point (ROP) and predict the Economic Order Quantity (EOQ), and collect user habits to continuously adjust the accuracy of the model to improve prediction quality. This system assists handling trivial matters in life by means of intelligent management, so that people can allocate and apply time more efficiently.

articleTitle: Design and Implement of Four Level Flying Capacitor Totem Pole Power Factor Correction
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Due to the requirement of high power density, this paper discusses the feasibility of flying capacitor multi-level (FCML) applied in the totem pole bridgeless power factor correction (PFC) circuit. Compared with the conventional twolevel totem pole PFC, the four-level FCML totem pole bridgeless PFC has the advantages of lower switching voltage stress and higher inductor equivalent frequency. In addition, due to lower switching voltage stress, the proposed topology can use gallium nitride (GaN) switches to replace Si-MOSFET, further improving power density and circuit efficiency. This paper analyzes the operating principle of the four-level FCML totem pole circuit. In the simulation and experimental results, a PFC with output power of 2.6 kW, input voltage of 90 to 264 V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rms</inf>, output voltage of 380 V and inductor equivalent frequency of 192 kHz is implemented.

articleTitle: Observation of clear magnetization and polarization reversal by local electric field in BiFeO₃-based multiferroic thin film with using metallic MFM tip with optimized magnetization
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: The induced magnetic and electric domain structures by applying local electric field of (Bi<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.4</inf> La<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.6</inf>)(Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.7</inf> Co<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.3</inf>)O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> multiferroic thin film (saturation magnetization ($M_{\mathrm{s}}$) of 75 emu/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, film thickness of 260 nm) fabricated using pulsed DC reactive sputtering technique were observed by magnetic force microscopy (MFM) and electric force microscopy (EFM). To observe clear induced domain structures, metallic and magnetic Co-Cr-Pt (film thickness of 30 nm) coated MFM tips with various $M_{\mathrm{s}}$ (500,700,900emu/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>) were used. With increasing the $M_{\mathrm{s}}$ of Co-Cr-Pt, MFM phase signal increased, but EFM phase signal decreased. The reason of decrease of EFM phase signal was that EFM signal included not only electric force but also magnetic force. As the results, the large MFM and EFM phase signal and clear domain images were obtained by using Co-Cr-Pt coated MFM tips with the saturation magnetization of 700 emu/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>.

articleTitle: Human Posture Classification Using a Dual Deep Convolutional NN With Silhouette Images
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: This paper proposes a dual deep convolutional neural network (DDCNN) model with two-view images to classify four human body postures, including standing, bending, sitting, and lying. The proposed image-based classification system consists of three parts. The first part segments a moving human body from the images captured from left and right cameras. A minimum enclosing rectangle (MER) of each body silhouette is then found. In the second part, the two silhouette images from the MERs are sent to the two convolutional networks in the DDCNN with AlexNet as the backbone network. The third part concatenates the flattened features extracted from the convolutional networks and performs classification using a fully connected network. Experimental results and comparisons with different deep learning models show the advantage of the proposed classification system.

articleTitle: Photonic Crystal Band Structure Prediction Using Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: We aim to develop an artificial neural network which can predict the band structure of two dimensional photonic crystals. We calculated two kinds of photonic crystals, square lattice and triangular lattice, using the wave vectors in reduced Brillouin zone, band number and r/a ratio to predict the eigen-frequencies of photonic modes

articleTitle: The Study of Sports Events Broadcasting Design –The 2022 National Intercollegiate Athletic Games as an Example
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Sports have long shed their conventional look and become more commercialized with coverage by the media and business activities. The continuous development of the media has drawn it closer to sports, and television broadcasting is an important facilitator in making sports events widely popular among people.The sports of table tennis require the use of a small court and a small ball played in a fast speed with strong rotation and variable landing points. These characteristics also lead to some limitations, which may greatly reduce audiences’ sense of immersion, experience and participation in events; and the screen design of television broadcast becomes very important. Therefore, this study takes the 2022 National Intercollegiate Athletic Games as a case study to analyze its broadcast screen design, hoping to provide suggestions on the screen design for similar sports events broadcasted in the future.

articleTitle: Exploiting Discrete Cosine Transform Features in Speech Enhancement Technique FullSubNet+
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: The highly effective deep learning-based technique FullSubNet+ employs a full-band and sub-band fusion model to fulfill the speech enhancement task. FullSubNet+ exploits the short-time magnitude spectrogram, real-and imaginary parts of the complex-valued spectrogram to learn the deep neural network that mainly comprises multi-scale time-sensitive channel attention (MulCA) modules and stacked temporal convolution network (TCN) blocks. To capture the phase information of input time-domain signals more simply, we propose using the short-time DCT-based spectrogram as an alternative for the real and imaginary spectrograms to be an input source to learn the FullSubNet+ framework. The preliminary experiments conducted with the VoiceBank-DEMAND task indicate that exploiting STDCT spectrograms in FullSubNet+ achieves higher objective speech quality and intelligibility in terms of PESQ and STOI metric scores, respectively, for the test set compared with the original FullSubNet+ arrangement. In addition, the STDCT-wise FullSubNet+ obtains a real-time factor (RTF) of 0.229, lower than 0.260, the RTF for the original FullSubNet+.

articleTitle: Investigation of Electrical Characteristics in Low-Temperature Polycrystalline Silicon Thin-Film Transistors Fabricated at Low-Temperature Process
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In this work, the electrical characteristics of the low-temperature polysilicon thin-film transistors (LTPS TFTs) fabricated at low-temperature process were investigated. To improve the process of AMOLED displays, a lower fabrication temperature is necessary to adopt and investigate since a lower fabrication temperature is suitable for flexible electronics. In general, the fabrication temperature of LTPS TFTs is about $400 ^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$. Therefore, to clarify the impact of lower fabrication temperature, $400 ^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$, $370 ^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$, and $350 ^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ are chosen as the maximum processing temperature during device fabrication for three TFT samples, respectively. It is found that the lower fabrication temperature device has lower on-current and higher on-resistance. However, a lower off-state leakage current is observed while the process temperature is declining due to trap-assisted thermal field emission. Silvaco TCAD simulation is discussed to support our findings.

articleTitle: Hardware Accelerator Design of Personal Identification with ECG Signal Based on Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: A hardware accelerator of personal identification with ECG signal based on artificial neural network (ANN) is proposed. ECG signal is used as the training data for machine learning to implement personal identification. The accuracy rate of identification is as high as 98%. Using NIOS to transfer data to SDRAM on FPGA, and design an ANN acceleration circuit to implement identity recognition function. Compared with the CPU for the same operation, the proposed accelerator has the same accuracy and more than 50 times speed improvement.

articleTitle: A 5.2 GHz Differential Down Conversion Mixer Design
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: This letter presents a 5.2 GHz differential mixer design that uses MOS switch and differential CS amplifier. The fully integrated mixer is fabricated by the tsmc 0. 1S$\mu$m BiCMOS process with its IIP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> of -13dBm, conversion gain of 15 dB, and the radio frequency (RF) and local oscillator (LO) to an intermediate frequency (IF) isolation of 15S and 139 dB, respectively. Overall chipset consumes 30. SmW with a supply voltage of 1.SV.

articleTitle: Magnitude to Digital Converter with Latch-Type Comparator and Dynamic Switching Current Scheme
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: A magnitude to digital converter is proposed using a latch-type comparator to replace the conventional opamp-based comparator. The PVT-dependent timing error can be relieved by employing the latch-type comparator and rearranging the decision control circuits. Besides, the power efficiency can be improved within the low and high speed operations. For increasing the linearity of the converting process, a dynamic current source is also developed to obtain the best coefficient of determination. A prototype of 10-bit converter was designed to operate at 40-kS/s with only 56.S-$\mu$W of power dissipations, respectively.

articleTitle: A Wireless Power Transmission System for Automated Guided Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: This paper designs and implements a 1.5 kW wireless power transmission (WPT) system for automated guided vehicle (AGV) applications through three-stage circuits. Since the power is transmitted by means of wireless magnetic field coupling, the equivalent model of the coupled inductor can be used to analyze the series-series resonant WPT to find the best design point suitable for the specification of the AGV application. The system also incorporates power factor correction (PFC) to improve power factor and a half-bridge series resonant converter (SRC) to efficiently convert the voltage to an input voltage suitable for WPT through zero voltage switching and synchronous rectification. Finally, The overall measurement efficiency at full load can reach 84%.

articleTitle: A 18-24GHz Low Noise Amplifier with Filter
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: This paper presents an 8-24 GHz low noise amplifier (LNA) with bandpass filter development that uses architectures of cascade and feedback. The integrated two stage LNA with bandpass filter is fabricated by the tsmc 0.18 $\mu{\mathrm m}$ CMOS process with its noise Figure of 2.66 dB, the stability of 2.37, and gain of 14.41 dB, respectively.

articleTitle: Digital Predistortion Technique Using Kernel Adaptive Algorithm for Nonlinear Power Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: This paper proposes the kernel adaptive filtering algorithm for digital predistortion in nonlinear power amplifier. The Saleh’s PA model is considered to describe the AM/AM and AM/PM conversion. Three algorithms, i.e., complex least means squares algorithm (CLMS), complex recursive least squares algorithm (CRLS), and complex kernel least means squares (CKLMS) algorithms, are developed to achieve better performance in terms of convergence rate and quality of solution. The proposed techniques are verified using QPSK modulation. The power spectral density, mean square error (MSE) and constellation plot are simulated and compared to verify the performances.

articleTitle: ENSO-based Ensemble Learning Approach for Tropical Cyclone Intensity Estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Estimation of tropical cyclones (TCs) intensity is crucial for disaster reduction and risk management. This study aims to estimate TC intensity using ensemble machine learning models. We utilized four Random Forest (RF) models to predict TC intensity. The input factors include TC’s location, central pressure, distance to land, landfall in the next six-hour, storm speed, and storm direction, which are extracted from the International Best Track Archive for Climate Stewardship Version 4 (IBTrACS V4). This dataset was divided into four sub-datasets based on the ENSO phases (Neutral, El Niño, and La Niña). Inputs for the RF models were taken from each sub-dataset separately. Results show that central pressure has the greatest effect on TC intensity estimate with the maximal root mean square error (RMSE) of 4.92 knots (equivalent to 2.50 m/s) and accuracy of 94-96 %.

Index Terms: Performance Of The Random Forest Model

articleTitle: Pose Measurement of Machine Tool Using Inertial Sensors
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In this study, the inertial measurement unit (IMU) is installed on the machine tool to measure the machine tool inclination. The acceleration and angular velocity signals measured by the accelerometer and gyroscope in the inertial measurement unit are converted into inclination angle signals. In order to improve the accuracy of measured angle, this study uses Kalman filter and complementary filter to fuse the data of the two signals to achieve the noise of suppression and improve the accuracy of measurement.

articleTitle: High Capacity Information Hiding Method Based on Interpolation and Ones’ complement
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Data hiding is an important technology for privacy protection. The proposed information hiding method is based on neighborhood mean interpolation (NMI) and $1'\mathrm{s}$ complement. Different from other previous schemes, the proposed method can embed at least one bit of secret data in each pixel. Also, in some cases, secret data is converted to its one’s complement. This makes the hiding ability better than other schemes. Experimental results comparing the proposed interpolation method with other methods show that the proposed method achieves more than 20% improvement in hiding ability and 8% improvement in PSNR.

articleTitle: A Fast Transient Response Hybrid LDO with Asynchronous Control Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: This paper proposes a fast transient response hybrid low-dropout regulator (FHLDO) with asynchronous binary search domino control mechanism. In order to improve the tracking speed, the domino binary search is used to achieve fast settling time. After asynchronous domino binary search mechanism completed, the analog low-dropout regulator loop still works to fine tracking region. Additionally, the non-clock voltage error detector enhances the detection of load transients. The proposed FHLDO is implemented in UMC 180nm1P6M. The maximum output current of 50mA, settling time is 31ns and the max current efficiency is 99.8%.

articleTitle: An RF-DC Converter IC for Power Charging Application
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: RF-DC converter integrated circuits (ICs) are presented for RF energy harvesting and power charging. To achieve wide incident RF signal variations that sketch the directing frequency band, an adaptive impedance matching network is used. The proposed RF signal to DC converter is fabricated in 0.18-um CMOS process. The simulated performances present the proposed circuit achieves Peak Power Converting Efficiency (PPCE) of 27% at 0 dBm input power, across 50 k$\Omega$ load resistance and 1 pF load capacitance and can provide an output voltage of higher than 2 V.

articleTitle: Fall Detection System for Depression Angle RGB Image based on Human Skeletonch
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In recent years, Taiwanese society is gradually aging, and the existence of fall detection systems is crucial to protect the health and safety of the elderly in their daily lives. In this paper, we used the Openpose human skeleton recognition algorithm to extract the 2D human skeleton information from RGB images and took actions to recognize the 2D human skeleton information by the LSTM. In order to solve the problem of incomplete and inaccurate human skeleton information extracted from the top angle camera, this paper proposes an algorithm that uses an object recognition model to assist in extracting human skeleton information to improve its skeleton recognition rate, and then enhance the accuracy of the subsequent LSTM model to obtain more accurate fall detection results.

articleTitle: Convolution Neutral Network Lightening and Hardware Architecture Acceleration Design
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: This paper proposes a network lightening method and hardware architecture for CNN networks. The typical convolution is replaced by a depthwise-separable convolution while sacrificing a little accuracy and can significantly reduce the single-layer parameter operation by 90%. And this method uses the application experiment of classification for the common backbone network - ResNet and VGG16. According to this lightweight method, a hardware acceleration architecture that supports depthwise-separable convolution alone is proposed, which can achieve lower bandwidth by using less on-chip memory, which is more advantageous in space.

articleTitle: Preliminary Study on Abnormality Detection of Airbox Sensor Device
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: As people’s awareness of environmental protection has increased over the years, air quality, particularly air pollution related to particulate matter 2.5 (PM 2.5), has become a concern for the general public. Thus, citizens in Taiwan have been voluntarily engaged in setting up airbox stations, leading to a sizable airbox air quality monitoring network. This network allows small-scale, real-time, location-based environmental monitoring. However, such an extensive environmental Internet of Things (IoT) network places pressure on the stability of data quality. Therefore, this study constructs a real-time sensor device abnormality detection approach.

articleTitle: Numerical Transient Analysis of a Wedge-Wave Ultrasonic Motor
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: This study is based on the actual drive mode of a prototype of a circular cylindrical wedge-wave ultrasonic motor (WW-USM). The contact friction model of the stator and rotor was established by the finite element software 3D ANSYS, and transient contact mechanics between the stator and the rotor were simulated. Given the actual conditions of the displacement and external force boundary conditions, the appropriate contact parameters, test the ideal convergence of the solution, obtain reasonable results, and estimate the motor performance curve of revolution speed and torque. In the ultrasonic motor prototyping of measurement characteristics, the use of piezoelectric induction, the size of the control voltage applied to the rotor pre-stressing to replace the traditional compression spring caused by uneven force of the rotor phenomenon, to avoid affecting the motor performance. The simulation results from 3D ANSYS indicate that the contact friction model between the stator and the rotor is crucial for the determination of the real constant.

articleTitle: Nanosatellite Power System with A Variable DC Bus Voltage for Improved System Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: The electrical power system of nanosatellites are challenging because they must be very small and lightweight, yet highly efficient and reliable since they cannot be repaired after launch from Earth. This work has designed a nanosatellite power system using GaN switches operating at high switching frequency. In order to optimize system efficiency, a dynamic dc-link bus voltage control method is being developed, but first the efficiency of the nanosatellite system at different dc-link bus voltages must be analyzed. Experimental data of the individual converters and overall efficiency are investigated and used to estimate system efficiency at different dc-link bus voltage combinations with loading current conditions. Experimental results point to the lowest dc-link voltage of 6 V as yielding the highest system efficiency for this nanosatellite design. The goal is to adjust the bus voltage to maximize system efficiency at any operating condition.

articleTitle: Design of a P. Vannamei White Spot Syndrome Virus (WSSV) Detection System Utilizing YOLOv5n
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Locally produced shrimp are in high demand in the Philippine market, accounting for over 90% of consumption. However, the White Spot Syndrome Virus (WSSV), a disease that can kill many Penaeus Vannamei shrimps within three to ten days after infection, has a substantial influence on the market. The existing manual approaches for identifying WSSV are inefficient and time-consuming. This research suggested an object detection model based on YOLOv5 for WSSV detection systems. The following metrics are utilized to evaluate the proposed YOLOv5n model’s performance compared to YOLOv5m and YOLOv5s:F1 score, inference time, mean average precision (mAP), precision, and recall. Regarding detecting shrimp WSSV, the YOLOv5n model outperformed other models. Raspberry Pi successfully implemented the intended YOLOv5n model for the WSSV detection system.

articleTitle: ESD-ability Enhancement of High Voltage pLDMOSs with the Discrete Source Side
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: The ESD capability of high-voltage pLDMOSs is improved in this paper by adding discrete HVPB distributions in the source side. There are five modified devices are investigated in this work, which are the discrete half HVPB and discrete HVPB with NPN, PNP, NPNP, PNPN arranged types. From the TLP testing results, the trigger voltage (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t1</inf>), holding voltage (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">h</inf>), and secondary breakdown current (I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t2</inf>) of these samples can be obtained. Finally, it can be found that the ESD capability can be enhanced by adding discrete HVPB distributions in the source side. This means that the ESD ability of these devices can be increased by increasing the conduction cross-sectional area of the discrete HVPB conduction path at the source end. It is found that the design of the pLD_HVPB_npnp modulation type is optimal as it has, the most pronounced increase in I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t2</inf>. And it is nearly 1.24 times higher than the reference device.

articleTitle: Spectral Analysis of Array of Sensors Based on Hierarchical 1D-DCNN
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: The research focus of this research will construct a novel 1D-CNN and hierarchical neural network architecture, namely Hierarchical Deep Neural Network (HDNN), and apply it to the development of spectral oxygen concentration measurement technology (DSL). Regression algorithm based on neural network. The HDNN we designed can segment the spectral bands in visible light and near-infrared to improve the measurement accuracy. The average error value in the training set is only 0.01091%, and the average error value in the test set is only 0.01117%, which is much smaller than the 2% of the traditional measurement deviation in the past. Demonstrate that this innovative approach has greater precision. All these analysis information shows that our method based on 1D-CNN and HDNN model for multispectral measurement is potential and highly feasible.

articleTitle: Automated Diagnostic Radiographs of COVID-19 Based on Deep Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: The COVID-19 outbreak has had a serious impact on Taiwan’s health care system. Deep Learning is an effective technology to help doctors make the most appropriate medical decisions for every patient in this crisis. In this study, we select four state-of-the-art Deep Learning–Xception, MobileNetv2, DenseNet169, and DenseNet201. Additionally, Transfer Learning is used for pre-training them before four models individually classify normal and positive COVID-19 chest X-ray images. Lastly, the best results reached 98.58% accuracy, 98.58% precision, and 98.42% recall.

articleTitle: Research on Kubeflow Distributed Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: As the accuracy of machine learning improves, the depth of the model will become deeper and the amount of input data will become larger and larger, and calculation will be too large to complete with one computer. Also, multiple computers are required for gaining more speed. To achieve distributed machine learning, Kubeflow and Kubernetes can be better managed through a graphical interface. This research used a cluster and the Docker virtual containers, With Jupyter Notebook to do distributed training with TensorFlow, this study compare the impact of the difference in the computing speeds of the devices on the overall computing time while maintaining the same accuracy and analyze what speed can be achieved with different devices working together.

articleTitle: Using Voice User Interface to Assist Designers in the Early Stage of Product Design
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In the early stage of product design, the designer's work first needs to find available domain information from their own cognitive memory or external resources, and then internalize this information into visual images for communication. At this stage, designers need to spend most of their time searching through a lot of references and thinking twice. They also face the dilemma of thoughts and associations that they cannot follow. The design conception stage can be said to dominate the subsequent design trends. Therefore, its process is extremely important for product designers. This study proposes the introduction of a voice user interface to improve the product design ideation process. Through expert interviews with design experts in product design-related fields, and according to 3E indicators, a semi-automatic design tool that combines voice technology to search for information is designed. Evaluate using the Think Aloud method to improve user convenience through voice search keywords. The result is the construction of a voice user interface system that helps designers search for information during the ideation phase while also incorporating digital age voice technology. The experiment found that the voice system does help designers to imagine, which greatly saves the time of searching for information, thus improving the convenience of experience.

articleTitle: Power Dispatching Control Strategy of Interconnected Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Under the promotion of renewable energy, some rural areas have set up disaster-prevention and islanded microgrids composed of decentralized power generation and energy storage system as emergency power supply. However, the unstable characteristic of renewable energy may lead to power outage in the microgrid. This paper aims to allow multiple microgrids to jointly extend the power support time through power sharing, and proposes an interconnected microgrid power dispatching control strategy based on edge computing. The microgrid with a higher percentage of stored electricity could transfer electricity to the microgrid with a lower percentage of stored electricity directly. In addition, the demand-side management is also performed under specifically assigned threshold to extend the power support time for the entire interconnected microgrid system in the islanded mode. The performance of proposal is verified with the 100-kW demo site in the campus of National Central University, Taiwan.

articleTitle: Preliminary Study of Cache Exchange Improvement based on RaptorQ and Tsunami
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Not only live video but also on-demand video have become essential parts of our daily life. In order to improve video transmission quality, Content Delivery Network (CDN) is utilized to accelerate video delivery from web servers to web clients, i.e., browsers. Regarding inside a CDN, this paper studied and proposed to use Tsunami UDP transmission protocol instead of HTTP and integrate RaptorQ to overcome unstable network conditions. Based on our initial experimental results, this paper can improve twice times of throughput between edge servers.

articleTitle: Automatic Alignment for Side-Channel Attack Against Cryptographic Modules
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Data encryption is critical for information security. Previous studies show that power analysis is a powerful tool for side-channel attack (SCA) against cryptographic modules. Therefore, it is essential to carry out power analysis to assess the vulnerability of cryptographic modules. The success of power analysis relies on aligned power traces, which is not easy without an external trigger point. In this paper, we propose an automatic power trace alignment method so that operations in power traces and be located without external trigger points. Experimental results show that the proposed method can be applied to various ciphers, including AES and RSA.

articleTitle: Research on Novel Thermal Insulation Structure of CMOS-MEMS Thermopile
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In this research, we discuss and analyze the thermal insulation microstructure which appropriately reduce the thermal conductivity and form a local channel where the heat flow is concentrated. As the channel becomes smaller, the thermal resistance increases and the noise will also increase. For the Johnson noise, the bandwidth can be reduced through subsequent electronic circuit signal processing. Although the response speed is sacrificed, the overall thermal sensing signal is improved in practical applications without introducing additional noise.

articleTitle: Traditional Chinese scene text recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Signboards, street signs, billboards, slogans and advertisements which can be seen everywhere in the urban area contain a lot of text and convey many information. If these street texts, which provide text information about the location, can be automatically located and identified in the image, it will be useful for application including scene understanding, smart cities, construction of smart transportation, robotics, automatic steering, assisting visual impairments or travelers. Therefore, this paper uses artificial intelligence technology to recognize the text in the scene. The recognition results can be used in various places to make daily life more convenient and technological.

articleTitle: A Study of Innovative Multi-functional Folding Umbrella with Solar Energy
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Recently, the cane umbrella products have been more and more widely used in all kinds of aged fields. With the decline in fertility in the birth of fewer children, the population will step into an aged society. The convenience of the elderly activities is also a major factor affecting their body and mind. Therefore, the development of assistive devices for the elderly is very important. Based on the above considerations, this study focus on design and improve cane umbrella, which combines the characteristics of trekking poles and folding umbrellas. The main purpose was to install a solar panel power generation mechanism at the top of the umbrella grip. The attached safety warning LED light is as an alarm buzzer system with certain frequency flashing. The crutch head adopts an articulated design to enhance the grip. In conclusion, the product takes the alarm function and night safety into considerations. Furthermore, it has a folding function and is easy to carry. It also has the appearance beautification effect of the work, realizes happy goes out, and feels warm when returning home safely.

articleTitle: Mechanical Properties of FeNiCoAlTaB Novel Materials
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">40.95</inf> Ni<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">28</inf> Co<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</inf> Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11.5</inf> Ta<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf> B<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.05</inf> (at.%) shape memory alloys are studied by microscope and tension test. The FeNiCoAlTaB is heat treated at 1250°C for 24 hours to obtain the homogenous sample. From the mechanical results, the fracture stress of 6 hours sample is around 758 MPa and elastic modulus is 139 GPa.

articleTitle: Research and development of robot arm applied to grinding path planning of metal parts
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: Using the Open CASCADE source to develop a robotic arm simulation grinding path for the metal parts is the purpose of this research. Firstly, a metal parts CAD/CAM grinding script file is created and translated into a special format for driving the presented robot arm. Then the geometric dimensions of the robotic arm and the belt sander in the program are built. Secondly, the forward kinematics and inverse kinematics models of the robotic arm are imported. Finally, the simulation and testing of the metal parts grinding path by combining the above translation program are achieved. Compared with the traditional manual teaching and correction of robotic arm path planning, the grinding efficiency can be improved in this study.

articleTitle: Design of a Low-power Compass FIR Filter for Electrocardiogram Signals Noise Removal
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In recent years, electrocardiogram measuring instruments have been developing towards miniaturization, which has also promoted the development of miniaturization of circuits and low power consumption. FIR filters are suitable for filtering out noise and revealing the obvious characteristic waveforms in an electrocardiogram, but they have high power consumption. Therefore, under the premise of maintaining stable performance and the advantages of low power consumption, this paper proposed a new architecture named the compass form FIR filter. When the high order number M = 256, the power consumption of the linear phase form was 28.2112 mW, while the power consumption of the compass form FIR was 24.0749 mW. The power consumption of the compass FIR was lower than that of the linear phase form FIR, with a difference of 4.1363 mW. Therefore, the compass form FIR filter designed in this paper had the advantages of low power consumption and high filtering performance under set conditions and high order specifications.

articleTitle: Comparing the Prediction Accuracy with Passenger Time Series of Taipei MRT under Different Deep RNNs
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In recent years, time series forecasting has been one of the hot research topics in prediction. This paper is based on the passenger time series data of Taipei MRT to make a prediction. By comparing the prediction accuracy with different deep RNN models; namely, LSTM (long short -term memory), GRU (Gated Recurrent Unit), TCN (Temporal Convolutional Network). Besides, LSTM and GRU are both modified RNN (Recurrent Neural Network) variants. TCN uses multi-layer dilated convolution and input padding, etc. techniques. This paper used three models of the deep neural networks to compare the prediction accuracy on medium-sized time series dataset Taipei MRT.

articleTitle: Electromechanical Simulation of Machine Tools
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: This research uses Patran, Nastran and Adams to establish the multi-body dynamic model of the single-axis experimental platform. The model can use to analyze the modal shape and mechanical. Matlab/Simulink is used to build a motor-driven servo system, The position and velocity loops are established by the PI control framework. Finally, the Adams and Matlab/Simulink is used to integrate the multi-body dynamics model and control loop of the single-axis experimental machine tool to achieve the result of electromechanical integration simulation.

articleTitle: A Grid Synchronization Strategy for Micro-Grid System
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: A grid-connected synchronization method is very important for distributed energy system. Apart from voltage, frequency and/or sequence requirements, the phase angle can be utilized to vary the power distribution both in the islanded and grid-connected mode. The expected transfer between islanded and grid-connected modes are needed in the operation of renewable energy systems. In this paper, a smooth phaseadjustment algorithm with predictive time based on the droop control is proposed. Some simulation and experimental results are provided to verify the validity of the proposed gridconnected synchronization method.

articleTitle: Building Wireless Observation Network to Track Biological Clustering
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In recent years, wireless sensor network has been widely used to automatically collect the field ecological environment and observation data, so that researchers can analyze the natural changes of the field ecological environment through the huge amount of data. In this study, biological observation data are transmitted back to the cloud server through wireless communication network, and new wireless communication technologies are developed to improve the data transmission mechanism and overcome the difficulties of remote wireless communication in field areas. In addition, the data transmission efficiency is improved to ensure that the data is successfully transmitted back to the server in real time and quickly, so that the observers do not need to go to the tracking target trap location to read the observation related data.

articleTitle: Designing a Roll Call System with Facial Recognition on Kubeflow
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: This study is based on the Kubeflow machine learning development platform in order to deploy a real-time roll call system. Kubeflow is based on Kubernetes, which is convenient for container management and portability. Face recognition is done in three steps. First, MTCNN detects a face in the image. Then, FaceNet extracts the features from the face. Finally, SVM finds out the identity of the face closest to the detected face. The average accuracy of the 30 classes in this study is approximately 94.2%, and the execution speed is about 35fps, with Intel Core i7-10700 CPU and NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 GPU.

articleTitle: Study of ESD Reliability on Gate and Drain to Source and substrate Stress by Structure Modulation in 0.18 μm 6 V nLDMOS Devices
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: The ESD strength of gate and drain to source and substrate stress in 0. $18 \mu m6V$ nLDMOS devices is studied in this paper. From the TLP measurement results we can observe that, firstly, as the length of the drift region increases, the trigger voltage $(V_{t1})$, the holding voltage $(V_{h)}$ and the second breakdown current $(I_{t2})$ will gradually increase. Secondly, as the length of the $\mathrm{S}\mathrm{H}_{-}\mathrm{P}$ region increases, the trigger voltage increases and has a saturation trend, the holding voltage has a little variation and the second breakdown current will gradually increase. Finally, from the test results for the HVPB modulation of the source region, from the test results the holding voltage increases little, the trigger voltage and secondary breakdown current have no obviously changes.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Interleaved Hybrid Modulation Inverter
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: The main purpose of this paper is to implement a high efficiency 3kW inverter with hybrid modulation method. Bipolar modulation and unipolar modulation are commonly applied for single-phase inverter. Compared with bipolar and unipolar modulation, hybrid modulation has advantages of low switching loss and high efficiency. The three modulation methods mentioned above are compared by their total loss, efficiency, total harmonic distortion (THD), common mode voltage and leakage current. In order to achieve the output power of 3kW, two-phase interleaved high-frequency switching legs are utilized to disperse the current, so as to increase the output power of the circuit and reduce the output ripple. In this paper, a 3kW hybrid modulation interleaved inverter is implemented, and the experimental result is demonstrated. The highest measured efficiency can reach 98.9%.

articleTitle: Diffraction Analysis of Focused Tilt Gaussian Beam
publicationTitle: 2022 IET International Conference on Engineering Technologies and Applications (IET-ICETA)
abstract: In ultra-high resolution displacement measurement with optical interferometers, beam tilt-to-length coupling is a major error in error budgets. We derive the complex amplitude distribution of a probe Gaussian beam under tilt after focusing by Fresnel diffraction equation. A decentered Gaussian beam is found, which may compensate this error.
